text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync on the Zetabyte POC timeline — need to lock owners for the last-mile integrations before the Wed demo. Who's taking webhook mapping and who owns sample-data ingestion?

Kevin Patel: I can own webhook mapping. Plan: add endpoint + mapping table, validate with sample events from their QA team by Tue. Will open a PR today. @Oliver can you review? :thumbsup:

Oliver Zhang: Got it, I'll review Kevin's PR. Tag me when it's up. Also we need feature-flag gating for gradual rollout (so we can disable if misbehaves).

Kevin Patel: PR #4321 created: "zeta: add webhook mapper + retry logic". Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

Jen Ortiz: Who's on sample-data ingestion? We need sanitized test corpus + embeddings prep. Success criteria: (1) end-to-end sample request under 600ms p95, (2) generated output matches their golden set for 90% of prompts, (3) logs surface customer_id and request_id for tracing.

Maria Chen: @Jen I'm taking ingestion ownership but need a hand from Eng for batch prep. @Oncall SRE can we get a temporary S3 bucket + perms for Zetabyte ingestion?

Oncall SRE: I can create a pre-prod bucket and IAM role. Need a ticket with exact path and data retention. ETA: EOD today.

Oliver Zhang: Re: performance, add a lightweight KV cache for prefix-heavy requests — that will buy us latency headroom. I'll draft a config and a small perf test.

Kevin Patel: Noted. I'll add cache toggles to the PR and a toggle in the feature-flag service config. Example flag: `enable_zeta_webhook_cache=true`.

Maria Chen: Checklist for Wed demo:
- webhook mapping PR merged (owner: Kevin)
- ingestion pipeline validated with sample corpus (owner: Maria + Eng)
- feature flag ready for canary (owner: Oliver)
- S3 + perms provisioned (owner: Oncall SRE)
- runbook for fallbacks if model hits latency (owner: Jen)

Kevin Patel: One more dependency: Zetabyte's QA needs a CORS whitelist entry for our callback host. @Jen can you ping their SE?

Jen Ortiz: On it. I emailed their SE (cc: kevin) and asked for cors update + 10 sample events. Will follow up in morning.

Deploy Bot: Deployment preview for branch `feature/zeta-webhook` passed staging checks. Image: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime:2026-03-17-014.

Oliver Zhang: If staging looks clean, we can canary to 5% traffic Wed morning, monitor p95 and errors for 30m then open to 100%. I'll set up the canary rollout in console.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Kevin — update the PR with a short testing checklist and mark ready for review. Everyone else, add any blockers here.

Kevin Patel: Will do, pushing checklist now.

Jen Ortiz: No blockers from PM side. I'll own the demo script and success-report post-demo.

Maria Chen: Thanks team :rocket:
